name: fire-factory
description: Starting base for a Firebase software factory: Keystone agent pack plus a product-free Cloud Functions, Firestore, Auth, and Next.js runtime.

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm run build --workspace=functions
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm run dev:api:memory --workspace=functions"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm run lint --workspace=functions && npm run lint --workspace=@fire-factory/scripts
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test && npm run test --workspace=functions
scripts.test:emulator: FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8080 FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9199 FB_PROJECT_ID=fire-factory npm run test --workspace=functions
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm run typecheck --workspace=functions && npm run typecheck --workspace=@fire-factory/scripts
